privatePage.title: HeptaBao 4a build original job discovery evidence

sequence: b4pRun prepare with exact whole root GO -> external public request/intent/armed whole
b4pRun invoke -> one rog/1 query -> private full SDK + one private Page + full read/sharing
b4pRun accept only after private byte/hash and owner proof; safe own-target projection only
unknownRules: Any Native, private creation, readback, sharing, hash or schema error stops; no retry, no cursor, no mutation replay.
Create Page uncertainty is retained with the same key; this SOURCE authorizes no second create.
Missing target in this bounded page does not prove absence.
Only literal owner_only=true accepted; absent/null/false/partial sharing stops before native semantic parse.
Current provider jobs/coverage schema is tested only with synthetic fixtures; an actual mismatch stops with raw SDK privately preserved.
Found target is retained metadata, not authoritative live status; a new explicit same-ID observation authorization is needed.
No original BUILD state field is changed, including its failed START and paused state.
reason: One new smaller read-only query reduces returned registry work after an observed time-budget error. It does not establish that 128 was an invalid parameter and does not guarantee recovery.
privateOwnerOnlyAcceptance: Positive owner_only literal from the documented owner scope, or the observed full-roster shape with no owner_only field.
Full roster: exact page/drive; personal metadata; no owning workspace/Space; owner is canonical user; direct shares empty; each of three inherited-source views complete and empty; null continuation.
Unknown/false literal, partial, any grant, identity mismatch, or nonpersonal destination rejects.
publicEntry: Only b4pRun prepare/invoke/accept; catch retains full exception privately and returns fixed {ok:false,stopped:true,code:private_adapter_stopped}.
